fixed.title: netstat live-host guard regex can never match
fixed.evidence: regex tested false against every LISTENING line of real Windows netstat -ano output; real rows have local/foreign/state columns only, the regex assumed a fourth
fixed.impact: the only protection against repairing under a live dsh was dead; in-memory domain write-back would clobber the repair
fixed.fix: 3-column regex /:3080\s+\S+\s+LISTENING\b/i with a verified format sample comment
fixed.verification: fires on synthetic :3080 row; zero false positives on existing listeners; end-to-end dry-run pass

fixed.title: realpathSync on deleted workspace path aborts the whole repair
fixed.evidence: reproduced: ENOENT from one bad record stops the for/of loop; remaining workspaces unrepaired
fixed.impact: a deleted/renamed project directory defeats the tool whose purpose is repairing damaged state
fixed.fix: per-record try/catch skip; Array.isArray guard for damaged sessionIds
fixed.verification: temp home with 1 valid + 1 deleted workspace: valid repaired, bad skipped, exit 0

fixed.title: corrupt workspace.json produces a raw stack trace

fixed.verification: code path review; covered by A2 harness layout

fixed.title: ChProjectTab mount-time list failure silently swallowed
fixed.evidence: .catch(function () {}) while the same component's load() reports via setError(messageOf(e))
fixed.impact: session dropdown silently empty on any list error; no user feedback
fixed.verification: TDD: self-check 15d fault-injection assertion red then green; full suite exit 0

fixed.title: no concurrency group
fixed.impact: wasted runners; late result can mask newest-commit result perception
fixed.fix: concurrency group ci-${{ github.ref }} with cancel-in-progress: true
fixed.verification: workflow YAML reviewed; CI validates on push

fixed.title: no concurrency group on publish
fixed.evidence: concurrent tag pushes can race npm publish
fixed.fix: concurrency group release-${{ github.ref }} with cancel-in-progress: false
fixed.verification: workflow YAML reviewed; Release validates on tag push
